end.summary: Discussed observations, hypotheses, laws, and theories.
end.parentNote: Tara practised distinguishing scientific statements by checking whether they are testable and evidence-based. They correctly identified distance and time as relevant observations and classified a testable cheetah statement as a hypothesis, then identified “same time, more distance” as a law example. Tara mixed up a law with something being proved; this was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, ask Tara to sort four examples into observation, hypothesis, law, or theory and explain one choice.
